verdict.rationale: Undermind's only documented public programmatic surface is its MCP server at https://mcp.undermind.ai/mcp (Streamable HTTP, OAuth with PKCE, user-scoped). Agents can drive its search, review, reading and workspace tools through it. The 'Programmatic queries via API' offering is enterprise-only and undocumented, and the vendor reference plus probes confirm there is no REST API, OpenAPI spec, or API reference. missing for 10: a documented general-purpose public API (REST/OpenAPI reference), API-key or service-account access, test environment, versioning/changelog, and public docs for the enterprise API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Every request runs as a specific Undermind user
